info.name: TicketFlow API Collection
info.description: TicketFlow API. Browser-style requests use the session cookie from Login (Postman keeps it in its cookie jar), so the collection sends no Authorization header by default. Folders marked "API key" and "MCP" send "Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}": set the collection variable apiKey to a key an admin issued with POST /api/api-keys (shown once, prefix tfk_). Never put a real key in the collection file. A request that carries a Bearer header is authenticated by the bearer alone (an invalid one is 401 even with a valid cookie). Errors are always {error, message, details?}.

variable.description: API key issued by an admin (tfk_...). Leave blank in the file; set it in your environment.
